desc: A fox-shaped Backrooms entity made of torn yellow wallpaper over black shadow, tail of bent fluorescent tubes, green exit-sign eyes. Chibi game pet sprite in exactly the same art style, palette, rendering and shading as the reference otter, 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, standing full body filling the frame, dark navy 1px outline, muted colors, no ground shadow, no glow.
